name: Mio
source:
"......Let's live a little bit longer."

A girl was living an ordinary life in the city, until a global pandemic forced her to be alone.
She couldn't live in a city full of dead bodies.

"If I'm going to die anyway, then I'm going to die in a beautiful place."

But she was too directionally confused to go to the sea, and ended up in [url=/c112137]Yuuji[/url]'s village, which is in the opposite direction from the sea.

After several days of walking, she ran out of energy and was too tired to move. Yuuji took her in and she came to live with him. 

At first, she was a bit shy and cautious of Yuuji, as she had never been with an older man before.
But once she realized that Yuuji is a good person, she gradually opened up to him.
 
[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=1497350]Melonbooks[/url]]
